html.preview.port.description: Preferred port for HTML preview. 0 selects an available port automatically. Unavailable ports fall back to an available port. Applies to new services.

terminal.integrated.fontFamily.description: Terminal font. An empty string inherits editor.fontFamily. Applies immediately after saving.

terminal.integrated.lineHeight.description: Terminal line height as a multiple of the font size.

terminal.integrated.scrollback.description: Number of scrollback lines retained by the terminal.

terminal.integrated.fontWeight.description: Normal terminal text weight: normal, bold, or 100–900.

terminal.integrated.fontWeightBold.description: Bold terminal text weight: normal, bold, or 100–900.

terminal.integrated.cursorStyle.description: Terminal cursor style: block, underline, or bar.

terminal.integrated.smoothScrolling.description: Enable smooth scrolling in the terminal.

terminal.integrated.copyOnSelection.description: Automatically copy selected terminal text to the clipboard.

terminal.integrated.mouseWheelZoom.description: Allow Ctrl+mouse wheel to change the terminal font size.

terminal.integrated.shellIntegration.ena.description: Enable shell integration in new terminals to report the current directory automatically. When disabled, split terminals can only inherit the last known directory.

terminal.integrated.gpuAcceleration.description: Terminal WebGL acceleration. Falls back automatically without interrupting the session when unavailable.

terminal.integrated.rightClickBehavior.description: Terminal right-click behavior. On Windows, default behaves like copyPaste: copy the selection, or paste if nothing is selected. Shift+right-click opens the menu.

terminal.integrated.enableMultiLinePaste.description: Multiline paste warning: auto warns when the shell has not enabled bracketed paste; always warns every time; never disables warnings.

terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.windo.description: Default shell profile for new terminals. null automatically selects PowerShell 7, Windows PowerShell, or cmd.

terminal.integrated.profiles.windows.description: Windows shell profiles. Supports path or source, args, and env. null hides an automatically detected profile.

terminal.integrated.env.windows.description: Environment variable overrides for new terminals. null removes a variable. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${userHome}, and ${env:NAME}.

terminal.integrated.cwd.description: Starting directory for new terminal tabs. An empty string uses the project root, or the user home directory when no project is open. Relative paths resolve from the project. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${userHome}, and ${env:NAME}.

terminal.integrated.splitCwd.description: Starting directory for split terminals: inherited uses the current directory; initial uses the source session's starting directory; workspaceRoot uses the current project root.

workbench.editor.openSideBySideDirection.description: Default direction for splitting and opening editors to the side: right or down. Split commands with an explicit direction ignore this setting.

workbench.list.openMode.description: File tree open behavior: singleClick previews files while keeping focus in the tree; doubleClick only selects on a single click. Double-click or Enter opens and pins the file, then focuses the editor.

editor.fontSize.description: Editor font size in pixels, from 6 to 100.

editor.fontFamily.description: Fonts for the editor and Markdown preview code, checked in comma-separated order against installed fonts. Font names containing spaces can be quoted. Applies immediately after saving.

editor.fontLigatures.description: Font ligatures for the editor and Markdown preview code, matching VS Code. false disables liga and calt (default); true enables them. A string customizes CSS font-feature-settings, such as "'liga' off, 'calt' on". Requires font support. Applies immediately after saving.

editor.lineHeight.description: Editor line height: 0 calculates automatically; values greater than 0 and less than 8 are font size multipliers; 8–150 are pixels.

editor.tabSize.description: Tab width in spaces, from 1 to 16. Detected file indentation takes precedence when detectIndentation is enabled.

editor.wordWrap.description: Word wrap: off disables wrapping; on wraps at the editor width; wordWrapColumn wraps at the specified column; bounded uses the smaller of the editor width and specified column. Does not change file contents.

editor.minimap.enabled.description: Show the code minimap. Always disabled in large file mode.

editor.formatOnSave.description: Format documents on save. HTML, Markdown, and other supported files use bundled Oxfmt and require Node.js; Rust requires rustfmt. Project configuration can select other formatters.

editor.defaultFormatter.description: Default formatter. null selects automatically: rustfmt for Rust; Prettier when selected by project configuration for other supported files (including HTML and Markdown), otherwise Oxfmt. Bundled Oxfmt requires Node.js but no language tools installation. You can also specify a listed formatter ID.

files.autoSave.description: Auto save: off disables it; afterDelay saves after editing stops; onFocusChange saves when leaving the current editor; onWindowChange saves when the window loses focus. Only modified documents with a file path and no conflicts are saved.

files.autoSaveDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds for afterDelay auto save.

files.exclude.description: File exclusion globs inherited by Ctrl+P. true enables a rule; false disables it. Supports when conditions for sibling files. Currently does not filter the file tree.

search.exclude.description: Ctrl+P exclusion globs, inheriting and overriding files.exclude. false disables the matching rule. Excluding open files requires matching their absolute paths, such as **/node_modules/**. Full-text search uses the search panel's exclusion patterns.

search.useIgnoreFiles.description: Apply workspace .gitignore and .ignore files to Ctrl+P.

search.useGlobalIgnoreFiles.description: Apply global Git ignore files to Ctrl+P. Requires search.useIgnoreFiles.

search.useParentIgnoreFiles.description: Apply ignore files from workspace parent directories to Ctrl+P. Requires search.useIgnoreFiles.

search.followSymlinks.description: Follow symbolic links when listing files for Ctrl+P.

litecode.nodePath.description: Path to the Node.js executable. null tries the Node.js installed by the app, then PATH. Backslashes in Windows paths must be doubled.

typescript.native.serverPath.description: Path to the TypeScript Native tsgo.exe executable. null tries the tool installed by the app, then PATH. Projects using TypeScript versions earlier than 7 use the compatibility language server.

litecode.typescriptLanguageServerPath.description: Path to lib/cli.mjs for the TypeScript compatibility language server. null uses language tools installed by the app, otherwise the bundled server. Loads the project's TypeScript version when available, otherwise the server's version. Requires Node.js 22.22.2 or later.

rust-analyzer.server.path.description: Path to the rust-analyzer executable. null searches PATH for the project's Rust toolchain.

oxfmt.path.description: Path to the Oxfmt executable. null tries the project, bundled Oxfmt, Oxfmt installed by the app, then PATH. The bundled npm version supports HTML and requires Node.js; standalone binaries do not support HTML.

editor.lineNumbers.description: Line numbers: off hides them; on shows absolute numbers; relative shows relative numbers; interval shows every tenth line.

editor.renderWhitespace.description: Whitespace display: none hides it; boundary shows boundary whitespace; selection shows it only in selections; trailing shows trailing whitespace; all shows all whitespace.

editor.rulers.description: Vertical ruler columns, such as [80, 120]. Also supports {"column": 80, "color": "#808080"}. An empty array hides rulers.

editor.renderLineHighlight.description: Current line highlight: none disables it; gutter highlights the line number area; line highlights the text area; all highlights both.

editor.guides.bracketPairs.description: Bracket pair guides: true shows all; active shows only the active pair; false hides them.

editor.folding.description: Enable code folding. Always disabled in large file mode.

editor.fontWeight.description: Editor font weight: normal, bold, or a number or numeric string from 1 to 1000.

editor.cursorBlinking.description: Editor cursor blinking style. solid keeps the cursor visible.

editor.cursorSmoothCaretAnimation.description: Smooth cursor animation: off disables it; explicit animates manual movement only; on always animates.

editor.scrollBeyondLastLine.description: Allow scrolling past the last line.

editor.smoothScrolling.description: Enable smooth scrolling in the editor.

editor.mouseWheelZoom.description: Allow Ctrl+mouse wheel to change the editor font size.

editor.wordWrapColumn.description: Column used by wordWrapColumn and bounded wrapping modes. Does not change file contents.

editor.insertSpaces.description: Insert spaces when pressing Tab. Detected file indentation takes precedence when detectIndentation is enabled. Does not rewrite existing indentation.

editor.detectIndentation.description: Detect tab width and space indentation from file contents. When disabled, uses tabSize and insertSpaces.

editor.quickSuggestions.description: Show completions automatically while typing. Accepts a boolean, on/off/offWhenInlineCompletions, or separate values for other, comments, and strings. Only modes supported by the current completion list are available.

editor.quickSuggestionsDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing automatic completions after typing.

editor.suggestOnTriggerCharacters.description: Show completions when typing trigger characters defined by the language.

editor.acceptSuggestionOnEnter.description: Accept completions with Enter: smart accepts only when the completion changes the text; off inserts a newline instead.

editor.parameterHints.enabled.description: Automatically show function parameter hints. Requires language service support.

editor.hover.enabled.description: Hover tooltips: on enables them; off disables them; onKeyboardModifier shows them while holding Ctrl or Alt.

editor.hover.delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before showing hover tooltips.

editor.inlayHints.enabled.description: Inlay hints. Requires language service support. Use Ctrl+Alt to temporarily toggle onUnlessPressed and offUnlessPressed modes.

editor.autoClosingBrackets.description: Auto-close brackets: always, languageDefined for language rules, beforeWhitespace only before whitespace, or never.

editor.autoClosingQuotes.description: Auto-close quotes: always, languageDefined for language rules, beforeWhitespace only before whitespace, or never.

editor.autoSurround.description: Automatically surround selected text: languageDefined follows language rules; quotes allows quotes only; brackets allows brackets only; never disables it.

workbench.editor.enablePreview.description: Use a reusable preview tab. When disabled, newly opened files keep separate tabs. Existing tabs remain open.

breadcrumbs.enabled.description: Whether to show file breadcrumbs. Markdown, SVG and HTML view menus remain available when disabled.

diffEditor.renderSideBySide.description: Show differences side by side. When disabled, shows differences in a single column.

merge-conflict.codeLens.enabled.description: Show accept actions above each merge conflict block.

merge-conflict.decorators.enabled.description: Highlight current, incoming, and common ancestor regions in merge conflicts.

diffEditor.ignoreTrimWhitespace.description: Ignore changes to leading and trailing whitespace when comparing files.
